lights.name: spot
lights.kind: theatrical LED accent spot on a drop pipe from a joist, aimed at the play shuttle

lights.name: high-bays
lights.kind: round LED high-bay fixtures (UFO type), cool white, on a 3 m grid under the joists; the room light

intent: From behind and a little above the family, deep inside the dark, space-themed play hall: the white soft-play shuttle lies across the frame, nose right, two hatches facing us. The girl (4) is stepping up into the front hatch, her right hand back in Jade’s open left hand; the boy (7, tall) is at the rear hatch, his left hand back in Dad’s open right hand. Both adults’ eyes are on their child. The accent spot’s shaft comes from high upper right toward us and lands on the shuttle’s tail; one mote hangs in it above the shuttle. No child’s face is seen.

beam.name: spot
beam.kind: theatrical LED accent spot on a drop pipe from a joist, aimed at the play shuttle
beam.mask: render the twin shot beam_<id> in flat mode: the lit volume is white, everything else black (figures and furniture in front of it occlude it)
beam.lands_on: play shuttle hull (padded vinyl, white, black belly)

mote.note: hero -> exit (drifts up out of the shaft at the last hit) -> after (where the gold dotted line stops)
